# Studio Ikigai

> Independent software studio in San Diego, founded April 2025 by Helen Ma (17 years at Apple: original iPhone/iPad teams, visionOS, Journal). Builds on-device AI apps for markets big tech can't profitably serve ("Micro Tech").

## Products
- Antiviral (https://getantiviral.app): on-device conversational feed curation from your own subscriptions, iOS & macOS, in TestFlight.
- Inner Voice (https://findyourinnervoice.app): vocal wellness app; Visual Voice Prints; CREPE, HuBERT and Whisper run on-device via Core ML; iOS, in TestFlight.
- Inner Voice Sing!: describe a song, an AI provider writes the instrumental, you sing it and are scored on-device.
